purpose: Retain the V1 provider-confirmed state-only completed vacancy spells, but replace the failed circular phase-null support with a non-circular common-shift null that preserves event geometry within physical MasterSite blocks.
input: Stage-B V1 state-only support JSON; no abundance magnitude is used.

shift_group.rule: All spells sharing a physical MasterSite and the same frozen consecutive phase block move together under one integer-year shift.

eligible_common_shifts.definition: Integer k values for which every event year of every spell in the shift group remains inside the same frozen phase_block_years after adding k.
eligible_common_shifts.rationale: Avoid circular wrap and prevent independent SiteID shifts from manufacturing pseudo-replication.

replication_gate.rule: All conditions must pass after removing entire shift groups with fewer than 3 common non-circular shifts.

prohibited: choosing a shift range from abundance outcomes
independent shifting of SiteIDs within a shared physical MasterSite block

decision.if_passed: Freeze V2 shift groups/spells and authorize only the V2 effect implementation after the V2 synthetic recovery audit passes.
decision.if_failed: Stop; do not lower shift-support or replication thresholds.
